description: This file contains Sass mixins for rendering carets (arrows) in different directions, used for styling UI components with directional indicators. It defines parameterized mixins to generate border-based arrow shapes, including bottom, up, end, start, and a general caret mixin that applies the appropriate direction-based styles.

methods.name: caret-down
methods.description: Defines a mixin to create a downward-pointing caret using CSS borders.

methods.name: caret-up
methods.description: Defines a mixin to create an upward-pointing caret.

methods.name: caret-end
methods.description: Defines a mixin to create a caret pointing to the end (right or left depending on context).

methods.name: caret-start
methods.description: Defines a mixin to create a caret pointing to the start (left or right depending on context).

methods.name: caret
methods.description: Main mixin to generate a caret with configurable direction, size, spacing, and vertical alignment, which includes applying the appropriate directional caret mixins.
